Competitive Intelligence

Expand competitor insights across local competitors and national chains efficiently and effectively, through in-house or third-party scraping tools
Efficiently track competitor promotions, pricing, media, and share of voice to identify patterns and trends to anticipate future activity
Architect and lead annual brand pipeline survey to track performance of our restaurant brands against national and regional competitors

Media Buying & ROMI

Partner with brand Marketing leaders and media buying agency to ensure media is efficient and effective
Lead a team that conducts post-campaign evaluations for return on marketing investment (ROMI) fuelling continuous improvement
Leverage existing tools including Sprout, YEXT, Zendesk, ensuring they are effectively set up and mined for valuable insights and action alerts

Radar & Strategic Communications

Leadership, Strategic Planning & Project Management

As a key leader of the Business Intelligence Centre, actively contribute to the Centre’s future vision, annual planning, business casing, and prioritization of projects
Secure stakeholder buy-in for key projects, and lead cross-functional implementation of new processes and ways of working
Lead, inspire, and develop direct reports while serving as a key leadership contributor within the broader Business Intelligence Centre and Recipe Leadership Team

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Commerce, Math, or Communications
8+ years of market research, consumer insights, media strategy, or brand strategy
4+ years leading a team
Strong familiarity of media buying, and best practices to measure marketing effectiveness
Strong interest in consumer behaviour and psychology research
Demonstrated experience managing marketing research, social listening, reputation management, and/or guest feedback programs
Ability to turn complex data into a clear “so what” and “now what” for senior executives
Experience working across marketing, finance, and technology teams, as well as experience managing external vendors
A drive to be curious, test, and learn

Experience in restaurants, hospitality, retail or consumer packaged goods (CPG) is an asset

Flexible/Hybrid work environment

Career advancement opportunities with a company that owns some of Canada’s most iconic restaurant brands
Industry-leading benefits, wellness programs, and total rewards programs

jobs.description:
With over 5,000 members across Canada and internationally, the Appraisal Institute of Canada (AIC) is shaping the future of real property valuation. Since 1938, we have championed professional excellence, elevated industry standards, and built public trust. Through education, professional development, and self-regulation, we award the prestigious Accredited Appraiser Canadian Institute (AACI®) and Canadian Residential Appraiser (CRA®) designations, empowering valuation professionals to make an impact in today’s dynamic real estate landscape.

GENERAL SCOPE OF RESPONSIBILITIES

The Senior Director, Operations is a member of the Senior Leadership Team and leads the Appraisal Institute of Canada’s (AIC) Member-service delivery, information technology and digital services, event operations, operational systems, process improvement, and operational resilience.

Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer (CEO), the role ensures reliable, responsive, Member-centred services aligned with AIC’s strategic plan and Board-approved priorities. It is accountable for operational performance, service standards, cross-functional implementation, resource planning, and continuous improvement within the Operations portfolio.

The role provides executive oversight to the Head, Information Technology and works with the other Directors, the Manager, Governance, Provincial Affiliate Associations, and external partners to deliver coordinated services.

Reporting to:
Chief Executive Officer
Direct reports:

Head, Information Technology,
Senior Manager, Member Services
Events Specialist
Location:
Ottawa, ON
Position details/conditions:
Permanent. 37.5 hours per week. Hybrid.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic Leadership

Contribute operational, technology, and service-delivery expertise to AIC’s strategic plan, annual operating plan, and major initiatives; translate approved priorities into plans, schedules, measures, and resource requirements.
Advise the CEO and Senior Leadership Team on service performance, digital systems, events, capacity, vendor performance, operational risks, and improvement opportunities.
Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve the Member experience, service quality, staff productivity, and implementation; promote accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and prudent resource use.

Member Services and Service Delivery

Direct Member Services standards, workflows, quality assurance, and escalation processes to ensure inquiries, transactions, and requests are handled efficiently, consistently, respectfully, and within service standards.
Monitor response times, resolution rates, feedback, recurring issues, volumes, and bottlenecks; improve Member-facing processes, forms, communication workflows, and self-service tools with IT and functional leads.
Ensure effective handoffs and referral of admissions, accreditation, professional-practice, complaints, governance, and financial-exception matters to the responsible department.
Coordinate with Finance and Corporate Services on dues, payments, billing, rebates, refunds, receivables, and financial controls, and with Public Affairs and Communications on clear, timely, consistent Member communications.

Executive Oversight of Information Technology

Provide executive leadership and direction to the Head, Information Technology, aligning technology priorities, investments, and service expectations with approved strategy, operating plans, Member needs, and resources.
Review technology plans, significant initiatives, risks, and performance; provide direction and escalate matters to the CEO and Senior Leadership Team as appropriate.
Integrate technology requirements into operational planning, service improvements, Member-experience initiatives, and organizational change.
Facilitate collaboration between IT and functional leaders to identify and prioritize business requirements, while respecting the Head, Information Technology’s technical accountabilities.
Work with Finance and Corporate Services to align technology investments with budgets, procurement, financial controls, and contractual requirements.

Events and Meetings Operations

Oversee the planning and delivery of AIC conferences, meetings, events, and related activities, including logistics, registration, venues, vendors, accessibility, schedules, risk planning, and post-event evaluation.
Approve project plans, responsibilities, timelines, service standards, and performance measures for major events and meetings.
Ensure event vendors and partners meet approved requirements, contracts, budgets, and quality expectations.
Coordinate with Public Affairs and Communications on promotion, branding, stakeholder and sponsorship communications, media opportunities, and public relations.
Work with Finance and Corporate Services on event budgets, contract review, procurement, payment controls, and financial reporting in accordance with policy and delegated authority.

Operational Planning and Process Improvement

Design, implement, document, and improve operational processes and service workflows; simplify work, reduce manual effort, and strengthen reliability, quality, and the Member experience.
Track Member Services results, event outcomes, implementation progress, process efficiency, and stakeholder feedback; use findings to guide improvements.
Lead change management for operational initiatives and maintain practical, current procedures, service standards, and staff training materials.
Support initiatives led by other departments where operational workflows, Member Services, event delivery, or change-management expertise are required.

Financial and Resource Management

Develop and manage Operations budgets, forecasts, resource plans, and business cases; monitor Member Services, event, vendor, and other operational expenditures within delegated authority.
Identify efficiencies, cost pressures, and corrective actions, and recommend responses to the CEO and Director, Finance and Corporate Services.
Manage purchasing, contracts, and vendor commitments in accordance with approved financial policies, procurement processes, delegated authorities, and budgets.
Contribute to organization-wide budgeting and resource allocation. The Director, Finance and Corporate Services retains responsibility for consolidated financial planning, financial controls, and Board financial reporting.

Operational Compliance, and Reporting

Ensure Member Services and event operations comply with applicable legislation, contractual obligations, privacy requirements, internal policies, and approved standards.
Implement corrective actions arising from service failures, audit findings, event issues, operational reviews, and other portfolio concerns.
Provide operational information and reports to the CEO, Board, and committees, in collaboration with the Manager, Governance and relevant Directors; implement Board-approved decisions within the portfolio.

Provincial Affiliate and Stakeholder Collaboration

Identify recurring affiliate issues and coordinate responses with the responsible Director.

QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible leadership experience in operations, Member Services, event operations, service delivery, organizational transformation, or a comparable multi-functional environment.

Director, CX AI Delivery

Who We Are

Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture

With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, Africa, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across eight core service areas: Digital Product Consulting, Digital Marketing Services, Data & AI, Strategy Consulting, Business Operations Modernization, Enterprise Applications, Cloud Engineering, and QA & Test Engineering.

From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are — all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company.

Location & Flexibility

This role will operate remotely in the United States
or Canada
OR be based out of one of our major North American office locations - Charlottesville, VA, Durham, NC, Columbus, OH, Boston, MA, Toronto, ON, or Vancouver, BC.

This role may involve travel of up to 25% to contact center and client locations.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Director, CX AI Delivery
: a consultant and delivery expert who can turn complex contact center and AI programs into predictable, measurable outcomes. You will lead delivery across our CX AI portfolio, spanning Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) platforms, conversational and agentic AI, agent assist, and CX intelligence, and serve as a trusted advisor to client executives. You will manage a portfolio of client engagements (generally ~$15–20M in revenue), directly lead delivery, product, and engineering leaders, and step in to stabilize and recover programs when needed.

This is a delivery-first leadership role with an AI lens. You will bring the rigor of a seasoned delivery executive together with a working command of how AI is changing CX: from AI-driven routing and virtual agents to copilots, knowledge, and agentic automation. You will help clients adopt these capabilities responsibly, at scale, and in iterative releases that get value into production quickly. You will also help evaluate vendor and partner solutions and decide how and when new tools enter the ecosystem.

This position reports to the Managing Director, CX AI Delivery and typically manages 8–12 direct reports, including senior managers, managers, and principal-level delivery and technical leaders. It is primarily evaluated on delivery success, client and team feedback, forecast accuracy, portfolio profitability, and growth of key accounts. This is an opportunistically billable position.

Responsibilities

Strategic Account Governance & Growth

Be the executive partner. Act as the primary escalation point and strategic advisor for client executives, ensuring TELUS Digital is viewed as a “Doctor” (consultative partner), not a “Waiter” (order taker).
Run portfolio health. Drive the commercial success of a ~$15–20M portfolio, leading Quarterly Business Reviews that connect delivery progress to the client’s long-term CX and business goals.
Grow organically. Identify expansion opportunities in existing accounts by understanding client pain points and bringing a relevant point of view on CX and AI. Support renewals, upsell, and expansion in partnership with strategic sales and customer success teams.
Extend into managed services and advisory as the practice matures: shape Day 2 support models, operational readiness, and advisory engagements that keep clients engaged after go-live.

Delivery Excellence & Risk Mitigation

Lead a global, multidisciplinary team across multiple concurrent workstreams, ensuring product, engineering, and delivery leaders operate as a cohesive unit to deliver measurable outcomes.
Manage risk proactively. Identify “red” and “yellow” programs early; step into recovery situations to provide clarity, reset expectations, and stabilize teams and client relationships.
Push for iterative delivery. Favor smaller releases and faster cycles over big-bang launches, especially for AI capabilities where learning in production is essential.
Optimize delivery models, balancing onshore/offshore teams, automation, and repeatable assets to improve margins and scalability.
Manage vendor and partner ecosystems. Work with CCaaS and AI platform partners (e.g., Genesys, Google, AWS, Zendesk, Five9, ElevenLabs, Cresta, Parloa) to deliver joint solutions as well as surrounding services in the client ecosystem.
Partner on pre-sales. Support the commercial team to shape innovative solutions and lead scoping, estimation, and handoffs into delivery so engagements start with clear requirements and goals.

Leadership & Talent Development

Coach and mentor delivery, product, and engineering leaders on leading their own teams and navigating complex client dynamics.
Build a high-performance culture with regular 1:1s and performance reviews grounded in radical candor and growth, delivering feedback upward, across, and down with grace and clarity.
Raise the bar on talent. Participate in senior-level hiring, contribute to the Delivery Playbook, and build career paths and skill development (including AI and platform certification pipelines).

Operational & Financial Stewardship

Own portfolio financials: gross margin, utilization, and effective billable rates.
Forecast accurately. Maintain precise revenue and resource forecasts so the business can plan hiring and growth with confidence.
Influence with data. Use reporting language, data visualization, and storytelling to influence internal and external decisions and inspire confidence in stakeholders.
Collaborate across the business with peers and practice leaders to improve internal processes and operational efficiency, and bring energy to moments that matter: new relationships, key presentations, and recovery situations.

Qualifications

10+ years in the technology industry, including 4+ years in a senior leadership role in a professional services, consulting, or agency environment.
Proven record managing a diverse portfolio of client accounts (ideally $10M+ in annual revenue) with a focus on retention and organic growth.
Experience delivering large-scale CX or contact center transformations that influenced VP- and C-level decision making.
Working knowledge of how AI is applied in CX: conversational and voice AI, agent assist and copilots, AI-driven routing, knowledge and content for AI, and CX intelligence; ability to discuss architecture, risk, and ROI credibly with both technical and executive audiences.
Hands-on delivery experience with one or more leading CCaaS or CX AI platforms (e.g., Genesys, Amazon Connect, Zendesk, Google); platform certifications and experience across multiple verticals are a plus.
Deep understanding of the SDLC and Agile delivery, with a track record of leading complex, custom-built software solutions from discovery to launch, and comfort with iterative, experiment-driven delivery.
Experience managing and coaching leaders across Product, Engineering, and Delivery, and leading large, globally distributed teams.
Strong command of professional services metrics, including gross margin, utilization, forecast accuracy, and effective billable rates.
Exceptional ability to navigate “recovery situations” and high-stakes client conversations with poise, clarity, and a solution-oriented mindset.
Ability to translate complex delivery data into compelling narratives for QBRs and executive stakeholders.
Understanding of regulatory requirements in contact center operations (e.g., PCI, HIPAA, TCPA, PIPEDA) is a plus.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Reporting to the VP, VAS Strategy & Operations, we are hiring a Director, Growth & Innovation Operations to accelerate the execution of strategic priorities across Altus Group’s Valuation Advisory Services (VAS) business. You will turn opportunities for commercial growth, operational improvement, and technology-enabled innovation into initiatives that deliver measurable results. You will directly lead a Senior Analyst and work with resources across the organization to strengthen accountability, improve visibility into performance, and build more effective, scalable ways of working. You will also personally own critical initiatives, develop plans, solve problems, and drive execution.

This is a hybrid role based in Toronto, Ontario.

What’s In It For You

Strategic, measurable impact. Altus Group brings together commercial real estate expertise, data, and technology to deliver value to clients. This is an opportunity to make strategy happen. You will play a meaningful role in advancing how VAS operates and grows, taking ownership of initiatives that improve commercial performance, introduce new capabilities, and create lasting operational improvements.

Influence the direction the business takes. You will work closely with senior leadership and collaborate across commercial, operational, and technology teams to solve challenges that extend beyond any one function. You will have the opportunity to bring structure to complex priorities, connect people around shared goals, and help leadership make informed decisions through clearer performance insights and accountability.

The chance to lead, build, and deliver. You will develop talent, draw on expertise across the organization, and remain close to the work that turns ideas into results. With a mandate spanning growth, operations, and innovation, you will take ownership and have the breadth and complexity to continue developing as a leader while building processes and capabilities that support the business over time.

Help shape the future of technology-enabled services. You will join a team actively exploring how AI, automation, and new technology can transform a people-driven professional services business. Rather than simply developing innovation strategies, you will help bring new capabilities into everyday operations, learn what works, and build scalable approaches that deliver meaningful business value.

Turn strategic priorities into results. You will translate complex business opportunities into clear objectives, actionable plans, and measurable outcomes. Drive commercial and operational improvement. You will identify opportunities to strengthen commercial performance, simplify processes, and improve efficiency across VAS. Bring innovation into everyday operations. You will partner with Product, Engineering, and business teams to evaluate and advance technology, automation, and AI-enabled opportunities. You will help translate business needs into practical requirements, coordinate implementation, and support adoption so new capabilities deliver value beyond launch.
Create visibility and accountability. You will own weekly and monthly reporting across commercial performance, pipeline, bookings, revenue, operational initiatives, and innovation adoption. Working with existing data and reporting tools, you will connect information across the business, identify trends and risks, and translate insights into clear recommendations and actions for leadership. You will establish practical operating rhythms that strengthen accountability and support informed decisions.
Align teams and accelerate execution. You will bring together stakeholders across functions, clarify responsibilities, and navigate dependencies that could slow progress. You will reconcile competing priorities, resolve roadblocks, and create the alignment required to move complex initiatives forward.
Lead and develop talent. You will coach and support a Senior Analyst while coordinating expertise and resources across the organization. You will balance strategic direction with hands-on problem-solving, helping build the capabilities, discipline, and ownership needed to deliver consistently.

You bring

The track record of delivering business outcomes. You have led complex, cross-functional initiatives in business operations, growth operations, transformation, product operations, consulting, or a related environment. You can point to meaningful improvements you have delivered, whether in commercial performance, operational efficiency, technology adoption, or how a business operates. Your experience extends beyond developing strategies or managing programs to owning implementation and results. Experience in commercial real estate, valuation, professional services, software, data, or another technology-enabled services business would be valuable.
The ability to create direction from ambiguity. You have taken ownership of business challenges where the solution, scope, and path forward were not clearly defined. You know how to assess what matters, challenge assumptions, make sound trade-offs, and translate competing priorities into a practical course of action. You create enough structure to accelerate progress without introducing unnecessary complexity.
The experience navigating complex execution. You have managed interconnected initiatives with multiple stakeholders, dependencies, and competing demands. You understand how to establish meaningful governance, identify risks early, and maintain momentum when priorities shift or decisions become difficult. You use performance measures and reporting to drive action and accountability, not simply to document activity.
The understanding of technology-enabled business change. You have partnered with Product, Engineering, or technology teams to translate operational needs into solutions that work in practice. You understand how requirements, prioritization, testing, release readiness, and change adoption connect to successful delivery. Exposure to AI-enabled transformation, workflow automation, or technology adoption initiatives would also be an asset.

You have worked closely with senior leaders and multidisciplinary teams, navigating differing perspectives and making recommendations that move decisions forward. The leadership approach. You have experience developing people and guiding teams while remaining personally accountable for complex work. You know when to delegate, when to coach, and when to step directly into a challenge. You are comfortable moving between executive discussions and detailed execution, and you measure leadership success by the outcomes your team delivers.

Mistplay is the #1 loyalty app for mobile gamers. Our community of millions of engaged mobile gamers come to Mistplay to discover new games to play and earn rewards. Gamers are rewarded for their time and money spent within the games and can redeem those rewards for gift cards. Mistplay is on a mission to be the best way to play mobile games for everyone everywhere! Download Mistplay on the Google Play Store  here  and follow us on  Instagram ,  Twitter  and  Facebook .

🇫🇷  La description en français est ci-dessous ⬇️ 
Overview
Mistplay is the loyalty platform for mobile gamers. Players earn real rewards for playing games on Android and iOS, game studios pay us to acquire players who stay, and our LoyaltyPlay offerwalls extend that economy into other publishers' apps. A rewards economy can sometimes attract people who want the rewards without the play, and the ways they try keep changing: device farms, emulators, multi-accounting, referral abuse, account takeover, spoofed playtime and purchases, and low-quality traffic on the supply we sell to advertisers.

AI has changed the nature of that fight. Attackers now use it to generate accounts, mimic real play sessions, write convincing appeals and automate offerwall completions at a scale and speed that rule-based defences were never built for. We believe the answer is to be better at AI than they are. We're looking for a leader who will build stronger detection, prevention and mitigation, including through the use of AI: agents that triage and investigate, models that learn faster than attackers adapt, and tooling that lets a small team cover a large and shifting surface.

You will be accountable for our fraud strategy, our fraud roadmap and the metrics demonstrating ongoing and improved fraud prevention the company runs on, and you'll report on all three to the Senior Leadership Team and the board. You won't do it alone. You'll work in a tight coordination with our Fraud Analytics Manager and an Engineering Manager, who bring the analysts and engineers; together you define the roadmap, and you are the one accountable for landing it, working with Product to get it into plans and shipped.

This is a hands-on role in the sense that matters: you'll be in the data, running investigations, prototyping detection logic, shaping enforcement policy and running the response when an attack hits. It starts as a senior individual contributor position, and we expect it to grow: as the function matures there is room for this person to take on direct reports.

What You'll Be Doing

Own the fraud strategy and roadmap. Keep a clear, current picture of where we're exposed and what it costs, decide what we tackle this quarter and next, and turn that into a roadmap the Fraud Analytics, Engineering and Product teams commit to. Bring new features, offers and reward mechanics through an abuse review before they launch, and push back when something isn't ready

Be the accountable owner of Mistplay's fraud metrics. Define how we measure loss, prevalence and false positives, make sure the numbers are trusted, and deliver regular updates on our fraud posture, strategy and progress to the Senior Leadership Team and the board

Lead detection and enforcement work with the Fraud Analytics and other cross-functional teams. Set the investigation agenda, dig into live attack patterns alongside the analysts, prototype the rules and models that stop them, and hand clean specs to engineering to productionise. Own the enforcement ladder, from warnings and holds through to account and device bans, and the appeals policy behind it, so that real players aren't the collateral. You’ll also work cross-functionally with our commercial and marketing teams to ensure coordination and resolution with our clients and our marketing channels

Stand up fraud on-call and incident response. Build the on-call rotation and the incident response playbooks and procedures for fraud events, with clear severity levels, escalation paths and communication to the business. When an incident happens, run it: contain the attack, coordinate analytics, engineering, support and finance, and keep leadership informed. Afterwards, own the post-incident review and report, and make sure the mitigations that prevent a repeat get prioritised and shipped

Protect the quality of what we sell. Set traffic-quality standards for LoyaltyPlay and our third-party offerwall publishers, decide how we score and act on publisher-level fraud, and own the install-quality story we tell advertisers, including how we handle disputes

Make the function AI-native. Bring LLM and coding agents into day-to-day fraud work, from triage and evidence gathering to first-pass investigations, with people making the final enforcement calls. Help the analytics team adopt them, and keep an eye on AI-driven abuse as a threat in its own right

Own our platform and vendor choices. Decide how we use Play Integrity, App Attest and our MMP's fraud tooling, evaluate device-intelligence and bot-detection vendors against measured results, and make the call on what we buy

Influence across the company. Fraud touches Commercial, Marketing, Engineering, Product, UA, Supply, Support, Finance and Legal. You'll be the person who keeps everyone clear on what good looks like and what they own, without needing formal authority over any of them

What We're Looking For

10-12 or more years in fraud, risk, trust and safety or anti-abuse, much of it at a consumer platform, mobile ad network, MMP or rewards business. You've personally dealt with several of the threats above and can talk in detail about what worked and what didn't

Comfortable and current in the data. Strong SQL, enough Python to prototype and analyse, and a track record of designing detection logic that ran in production, even if someone else deployed it

Sharp analytical and critical reasoning: you can size a loss, weigh it against the cost of a control, and make a call you can defend to a CFO

Experience owning a fraud or risk strategy and roadmap, and presenting it to senior leadership or a board

You've run fraud or security incidents end to end, ideally having set up the on-call and incident response process yourself, and you can show how your post-incident work stopped the same thing happening twice

Proven ability to get things done through teams you don't manage, and to partner well with analytics and engineering leaders who do

AI-forward in practice: you use LLM and coding agents in your own work, you've applied AI to detection or investigation before, and you have a grounded view of where it helps and where a human has to decide

Working familiarity with Play Integrity, App Attest or DeviceCheck, MMP fraud suites and the device-intelligence vendor landscape

Strong communication and collaborative skills, including strong follow-through

Nice to have: Rewarded gaming, offerwall or incentivized UA experience; Databricks or Spark; graph or link analysis; mobile client security knowledge; prior people management or a desire to grow into it

What Mistplay Offers

Real ownership of a domain that protects revenue, player trust and advertiser relationships, and presenting fraud strategy and results directly to the Senior Leadership Team and the board.

A Fraud Analytics team and an Engineering Manager as your day-to-day partners, inside an AI forward, fast paced engineering culture 

A role designed to grow with you, including the option to build and lead a team as the function expands

Competitive compensation and benefits package.

Interview Process
A conversation about your experience, a fraud strategy case & a hands-on data exercise (AI assistants welcome), and an onsite conversation with the CTO & Fraud Analytics Manager & Fraud Engineering Manager where you walk through your case the way you would on-the-job with senior leadership.

🇫🇷 Description en français

Aperçu du poste
Mistplay est la plateforme de fidélisation pour les joueurs mobiles. Les joueurs gagnent de vraies récompenses en jouant à des jeux sur Android et iOS, les studios de jeux nous paient pour acquérir des joueurs engagés, et nos mur d'offres LoyaltyPlay étendent cette économie aux applications d'autres éditeurs. Une économie de récompenses peut parfois attirer des personnes qui souhaitent obtenir des récompenses sans jouer, et leurs méthodes évoluent continuellement : fermes d'appareils, émulateurs, comptes multiples, abus de parrainage, prise de contrôle de compte, falsification du temps de jeu et des achats, et trafic de faible qualité sur l'inventaire que nous vendons aux annonceurs.

L'IA a modifié la nature de cette lutte. Les fraudeurs l'utilisent désormais pour générer des comptes, imiter de vraies sessions de jeu, rédiger des appels convaincants et automatiser la réalisation d'offres à une échelle et une vitesse auxquelles les défenses basées sur des règles n'ont jamais été préparées. Nous croyons que la solution consiste à être meilleurs qu'eux en matière d'IA. Nous recherchons un leader qui saura bâtir une détection, une prévention et une atténuation plus fortes, notamment grâce à l'utilisation de l'IA : des agents qui trient et enquêtent, des modèles qui apprennent plus vite que les fraudeurs s'adaptent, et des outils permettant à une petite équipe de couvrir une surface vaste et évolutive.

Vous serez responsable de notre stratégie anti-fraude, de notre feuille de route anti-fraude et des indicateurs démontrant une prévention continue et améliorée sur lesquels l'entreprise s'appuie, et vous rendrez compte de ces trois éléments à l'équipe de direction principale et au conseil d'administration. Vous ne le ferez pas seul. Vous travaillerez en étroite coordination avec notre gestionnaire de l'analyse de la fraude et un gestionnaire de l'ingénierie, qui dirigent les analystes et les ingénieurs; ensemble, vous définirez la feuille de route, et vous serez la personne responsable de sa réalisation, en collaborant avec l'équipe Produit pour l'intégrer aux plans et la déployer.

Il s'agit d'un rôle concret au sens le plus important : vous serez dans les données, mènerez des enquêtes, prototyoerez la logique de détection, façonnerez la politique d'application des mesures et gérerez la réponse lorsqu'une attaque survient. Il s'agit au départ d'un poste de spécialiste individuel senior, et nous nous attendons à ce qu'il évolue : à mesure que la fonction mûrit, cette personne pourra prendre en charge des collaborateurs directs.

Ce que vous ferez

Détenir la stratégie et la feuille de route anti-fraude. Maintenir une vision claire et actuelle de nos vulnérabilités et de ce qu'elles coûtent, décider de nos priorités pour ce trimestre et le suivant, et transformer cela en une feuille de route envers laquelle les équipes d'Analyse de la fraude, d'Ingénierie et de Produit s'engagent. Soumettre les nouvelles fonctionnalités, offres et mécaniques de récompense à une révision des risques d'abus avant leur lancement, et repousser ce qui n'est pas prêt

Être le responsable ultime des indicateurs de fraude de Mistplay. Définir notre manière de mesu

jobs.description:
Director, CX AI Delivery

Who We Are

Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture

With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, Africa, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across eight core service areas: Digital Product Consulting, Digital Marketing Services, Data & AI, Strategy Consulting, Business Operations Modernization, Enterprise Applications, Cloud Engineering, and QA & Test Engineering.

From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are — all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company.

Location & Flexibility

This role will operate remotely in the United States
or Canada
OR be based out of one of our major North American office locations - Charlottesville, VA, Durham, NC, Columbus, OH, Boston, MA, Toronto, ON, or Vancouver, BC.

This role may involve travel of up to 25% to contact center and client locations.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Director, CX AI Delivery
: a consultant and delivery expert who can turn complex contact center and AI programs into predictable, measurable outcomes. You will lead delivery across our CX AI portfolio, spanning Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) platforms, conversational and agentic AI, agent assist, and CX intelligence, and serve as a trusted advisor to client executives. You will manage a portfolio of client engagements (generally ~$15–20M in revenue), directly lead delivery, product, and engineering leaders, and step in to stabilize and recover programs when needed.

This is a delivery-first leadership role with an AI lens. You will bring the rigor of a seasoned delivery executive together with a working command of how AI is changing CX: from AI-driven routing and virtual agents to copilots, knowledge, and agentic automation. You will help clients adopt these capabilities responsibly, at scale, and in iterative releases that get value into production quickly. You will also help evaluate vendor and partner solutions and decide how and when new tools enter the ecosystem.

This position reports to the Managing Director, CX AI Delivery and typically manages 8–12 direct reports, including senior managers, managers, and principal-level delivery and technical leaders. It is primarily evaluated on delivery success, client and team feedback, forecast accuracy, portfolio profitability, and growth of key accounts. This is an opportunistically billable position.

Responsibilities

Strategic Account Governance & Growth

Be the executive partner. Act as the primary escalation point and strategic advisor for client executives, ensuring TELUS Digital is viewed as a “Doctor” (consultative partner), not a “Waiter” (order taker).
Run portfolio health. Drive the commercial success of a ~$15–20M portfolio, leading Quarterly Business Reviews that connect delivery progress to the client’s long-term CX and business goals.
Grow organically. Identify expansion opportunities in existing accounts by understanding client pain points and bringing a relevant point of view on CX and AI. Support renewals, upsell, and expansion in partnership with strategic sales and customer success teams.
Extend into managed services and advisory as the practice matures: shape Day 2 support models, operational readiness, and advisory engagements that keep clients engaged after go-live.

Delivery Excellence & Risk Mitigation

Lead a global, multidisciplinary team across multiple concurrent workstreams, ensuring product, engineering, and delivery leaders operate as a cohesive unit to deliver measurable outcomes.
Manage risk proactively. Identify “red” and “yellow” programs early; step into recovery situations to provide clarity, reset expectations, and stabilize teams and client relationships.
Push for iterative delivery. Favor smaller releases and faster cycles over big-bang launches, especially for AI capabilities where learning in production is essential.
Optimize delivery models, balancing onshore/offshore teams, automation, and repeatable assets to improve margins and scalability.
Manage vendor and partner ecosystems. Work with CCaaS and AI platform partners (e.g., Genesys, Google, AWS, Zendesk, Five9, ElevenLabs, Cresta, Parloa) to deliver joint solutions as well as surrounding services in the client ecosystem.
Partner on pre-sales. Support the commercial team to shape innovative solutions and lead scoping, estimation, and handoffs into delivery so engagements start with clear requirements and goals.

Leadership & Talent Development

Coach and mentor delivery, product, and engineering leaders on leading their own teams and navigating complex client dynamics.
Build a high-performance culture with regular 1:1s and performance reviews grounded in radical candor and growth, delivering feedback upward, across, and down with grace and clarity.
Raise the bar on talent. Participate in senior-level hiring, contribute to the Delivery Playbook, and build career paths and skill development (including AI and platform certification pipelines).

Operational & Financial Stewardship

Own portfolio financials: gross margin, utilization, and effective billable rates.
Forecast accurately. Maintain precise revenue and resource forecasts so the business can plan hiring and growth with confidence.
Influence with data. Use reporting language, data visualization, and storytelling to influence internal and external decisions and inspire confidence in stakeholders.
Collaborate across the business with peers and practice leaders to improve internal processes and operational efficiency, and bring energy to moments that matter: new relationships, key presentations, and recovery situations.

Qualifications

10+ years in the technology industry, including 4+ years in a senior leadership role in a professional services, consulting, or agency environment.
Proven record managing a diverse portfolio of client accounts (ideally $10M+ in annual revenue) with a focus on retention and organic growth.
Experience delivering large-scale CX or contact center transformations that influenced VP- and C-level decision making.
Working knowledge of how AI is applied in CX: conversational and voice AI, agent assist and copilots, AI-driven routing, knowledge and content for AI, and CX intelligence; ability to discuss architecture, risk, and ROI credibly with both technical and executive audiences.
Hands-on delivery experience with one or more leading CCaaS or CX AI platforms (e.g., Genesys, Amazon Connect, Zendesk, Google); platform certifications and experience across multiple verticals are a plus.
Deep understanding of the SDLC and Agile delivery, with a track record of leading complex, custom-built software solutions from discovery to launch, and comfort with iterative, experiment-driven delivery.
Experience managing and coaching leaders across Product, Engineering, and Delivery, and leading large, globally distributed teams.
Strong command of professional services metrics, including gross margin, utilization, forecast accuracy, and effective billable rates.
Exceptional ability to navigate “recovery situations” and high-stakes client conversations with poise, clarity, and a solution-oriented mindset.
Ability to translate complex delivery data into compelling narratives for QBRs and executive stakeholders.
Understanding of regulatory requirements in contact center operations (e.g., PCI, HIPAA, TCPA, PIPEDA) is a plus.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire and promote, are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

jobs.description:
Founded in 2000 by three former Royal Canadian Air Force (RCAF) CF-18 fighter pilots who identified an opportunity to improve military readiness training, Top Aces has since established itself as the world leader in contracted adversary air (ADAIR) services and joint terminal attack controller (JTAC) training.

We pride ourselves on our unblemished safety record, having flown an industry leading 130,000+ hours of operational training without accident in support of customers worldwide, including Canada, the U.S., Germany, and multiple other NATO allies and international partner nations.

Our vision is to be the most trusted provider of innovative defense training solutions, continuously elevating standards in an industry where "Experience Matters." This commitment to innovation and technology ensures we remain adaptable, training allied militaries to succeed against evolving threats.

Top Aces’ dynamic team contributes to delivering on our purpose of training the next generation of combat leaders by living our values of Service, Integrity, Excellence, and Together every day!

Join our team!

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

The Director FP&A and Capital Investment is a key member of the company’s finance team and is responsible for supporting all financial planning and analysis activities across the International Division of Top Aces Inc. The director will be responsible for the division’s annual budget process, financial forecasting, financial strategic planning and business performance analysis activities. Additionally, the director will be responsible for supporting the effort to enhance the company’s continuous improvement initiatives aimed at improving profitability and efficiency. The director will provide project financial support, return on investment (ROI) analysis along with KPI development, measurement and analysis. The successful candidate will have demonstrable leadership competencies, strong attention to detail, and will work well under pressure in a fast-paced environment. The candidate will demonstrate a successful track record of working collaboratively in a dynamic environment and a matrix organizational structure.

Own the division’s annual budgeting and financial planning process (quarterly forecasts and strategic plan 5-year forecast) and review all associated financial plans and budgets.
Develop, lead, and manage core FP&A activities.
Lead the development of P&L, balance sheet and cash flow forecasts and partner with internal stakeholders to optimize working capital (prepayments, inventory) and cash flow generation.
Lead the development of scenario analysis, sensitivity analysis and risks & opportunities.

Oversee capex financial management and capex forecasting improvement initiatives.
Lead inventory financial management and work with key stakeholders to optimize the level of inventory.
Oversee the preparation of the International Division monthly management accounts, FP&A reports and dashboards, including presentations to SLT and the company’s Board of Directors.
Support the division’s Senior Leadership Team (SLT) to evaluate and review new business and investment opportunities, including new business pricing, client Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), Return on Investment (ROI), payback period and return on capital (RONA) analyses.
Support the executive team decision-making by providing insightful data and analysis with the objective of improving Top Aces’ profitability and efficiency.
Build and develop the skill sets of finance professionals under her/his direction.

Education and/or Work Experience Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree required with concentration in finance and/or accounting or comparable business field preferred.
CPA and/or MBA preferred
10-15 years of experience in relevant accounting, or financial leadership roles.
Significant expertise with data analysis and reporting.
Ability to handle multiple assignments on a timely basis with a high degree of accuracy.
High level of motivation and aptitude for problem solving, with a strong attention to detail.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills as well as strategic thinking to effectively interface with external stakeholders and the division’s Senior Leadership Team.
Ability to translate financial data into strategic insights.
Able to work in a fast-paced environment with tight deadlines, possessing a high sense of urgency.
Ability to perform all work in support of our Corporate Values of Excellence, Service, Integrity … Together.

Working Conditions:

May be required to travel from time to time
May be required to work overtime or longer hours when Top Aces Requires

Supervisory, Training and Advisory Responsibilities:

May be required to provide regular guidance, advice and training, as requested by the supervisor, to other employees supporting the function.

Occupational Health and Safety:

Employees are responsible for:

Working in compliance with Occupational Health and Safety acts and regulations
Following safe work practices and procedures and using safeguards and personal protective equipment
Reporting hazards (such as unsafe situations and activities) to their supervisor immediately.

Security Clearance Requirements/ CGP / ITAR:

Position requires Level II clearance with the Canadian Government and the ability to gain access to the Canadian Controlled Goods Program

A work environment in which service, integrity, excellence and teamwork are highly valued;
Opportunities for development and growth;
Multidisciplinary and multicultural collaboration at a local and global level;
A flexible schedule;
Attractive benefit plan.

Come share your passion with us! Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered, and challenged to be your best self.

jobs.description:
Job Type: Permanent Full-Time

Work Location: Onsite ( CLC Headquarters and local agency designations)

This is to fill an existing position

Position Summary

Community Living Cambridge (CLC) supports individuals with developmental disabilities by upholding their rights, dignity, and confidentiality in alignment with CLC’s Mission, Vision and Values. As a key member of the Executive Leadership Team (ELT), the Director of Finance and Administrative Services
provides strategic executive oversight and leadership of all financial, administrative, and revenue-generating functions while ensuring full compliance with legislative, regulatory and funding mandates.
The Director oversees accounting, strategic budgeting, cash flow, investments, payroll, AR/AP, financial reporting, risk management, IT infrastructure, capital assets, vehicle fleet operations, and Ministry of Children, Community and Social Services (MCCSS) compliance. This executive role drives revenue strategies, optimizes financial models, and collaborates with the Executive Director and cross-functional ELT members to align financial goals with CLC’s strategic objectives.
Core Responsibilities

1. Executive Leadership & Strategic Governance

·       Actively contribute as a key ELT member to organizational strategy, high-level decision-making, and policy formulation.
·       Translate complex financial data into actionable strategic insights for the ELT, Board of Directors, and committees.
·       Regularly present financial statements, forecasts, and updates to the Board, Finance Committee, and Treasurer.
·       Serve as Executive Lead for the annual financial audit, ensuring pre-audit preparation and steering necessary adjustments.
·       Participate on the collective bargaining negotiating team and provide financial/administrative advice across CLC operations.
·       Recommend, develop, and implement financial policies aligned with strategic goals and fiscal integrity.
2. Financial Stewardship, Accounting & Ministry Compliance

·       Ensure organizational asset stewardship through rigorous internal controls and compliance with reporting obligations.
·       Direct and evaluate all accounting operations to drive business process efficiency and continuous improvement.
·       Lead a participatory comprehensive annual budgeting process, presenting draft budgets to the ELT for review and deliberation, with finalized budgets presented to the Board.
·       Review financial statements jointly prepared with the Associate Director of Finance and Administration, review with the Executive Director and Treasurer, and manage monthly forecasting.
·       Ensure absolute compliance with MCCSS documentation, reporting, and regulatory standards.
·       Conduct supported individual personal financial audits, oversee discrepancy reporting, and deliver quarterly compliance reports to the Board.
3. Administrative Operations, IT, Procurement & Risk Management

·       Maintain ultimate executive oversight of Information Technology (IT), cybersecurity, systems, and administrative processes.
·       Manage institutional procurement, mortgages, vehicle fleet operations, leases, investments, and resource allocation.
·       Oversee risk management frameworks, ensuring adequate insurance coverage for buildings, equipment, vehicles, and general liability.
·       Provide direct managerial oversight to the Associate Director of Finance and Administration and the IT Specialist.
4. Revenue Growth & Stakeholder Relations

·       Identify revenue opportunities, optimize existing streams, and execute comprehensive short- and long-term revenue growth strategies.
·       Build effective working relationships with staff, funding partners, MCCSS, and external stakeholders.
·       Collaborate across ELT colleagues to align revenue and operational goals with CLC’s mission.
5. Professional Standards & Safety

·       Abide by CLC health and safety policies, utilize safe practices, and report hazards immediately.
·       Complete mandatory training and recertifications (First Aid/CPR, Safe Management/Crisis Intervention).
·       Operate strictly within program frameworks, collective agreements, and confidentiality standards.
6. Other

jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.

Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

Job Description

Who are you?

You are an expert Associate Director in Cost Management
with a minimum of 15+ years post-graduate experience
looking for the next step or are currently undertaking a similar role in a similar environment.

As an Associate Director in Cost Management, you will lead the delivery of high‑quality cost management services across all project stages. You will own cost deliverables, provide clear commercial and risk advice, manage change and procurement processes, and interface closely with clients, and project teams. You will also contribute to business development, knowledge management, and the mentoring of junior team members.

As an Associate Director in Cost Management, you will be involved in:

Strategic Cost Advisory

Serve as a senior advisor to clients on project cost, commercial strategy, governance, procurement, and delivery approaches.
Provide independent recommendations regarding cost management best practices, market trends, procurement strategies, and commercial frameworks.
Advise clients on cost and risk implications associated with various project delivery models, including Progressive Design-Build (PDB), Design-Build, EPC, Alliance, and EPCM.
Facilitate executive discussions regarding project affordability, value optimization, risk allocation, and commercial decision-making.
Provide strategic guidance on industry practices, market trends, and emerging approaches to cost management and project delivery.

Pre-Contract Services

Lead the development and review of conceptual, Class 5 through Class 1 estimates.
Oversee quantity-based, parametric, benchmark-driven, and detailed estimating activities.
Prepare detailed cost plans, elemental cost analyses, and budget validations from concept through final investment decision.
Conduct estimate validation, constructability, and cost challenge workshops with project stakeholders.
Assess estimate maturity and alignment with project scope development.
Support business cases, investment approvals, and funding submissions through robust cost development and assurance.

Progressive Design-Build & Collaborative Cost Development

Support clients throughout Progressive Design-Build procurement and project development phases.
Lead collaborative estimate development, validation workshops, and open-book cost reviews involving owners, designers, contractors, and key stakeholders.
Establish and facilitate a structured Collaborative Cost Validation Framework to ensure transparency, alignment, and confidence in project budgets throughout design development and project execution.
Facilitate target value design exercises, cost alignment workshops, and commercial discussions between project participants.
Review and challenge assumptions related to quantities, productivity, labour rates, equipment pricing, construction methodologies, risk allowances, contingency levels, escalation, and contractor pricing while maintaining a collaborative and partnership-oriented environment.
Support target price development and validation processes under collaborative contracting arrangements.

Cost Management, Forecasting & Financial Controls

Lead the preparation of detailed cost plans, estimates, elemental analyses, and budget validations throughout the project lifecycle, from concept development through project closeout.
Develop and maintain project cost models, cash flow forecasts, cost reports, dashboards, and financial performance metrics.
Monitor project budgets and perform cost forecasting, earned value assessments, and cost-to-complete analyses.
Track contingencies, allowances, escalation provisions, and management reserves to support effective project governance.
Manage contractor and subcontractor cost submissions, estimate updates, project forecasts, and budget reconciliations.
Provide independent forecasting and financial analysis to support executive and governance decision-making.

Cost Assurance & Independent Review

Develop and execute cost assurance methodologies and governance frameworks for major capital projects and programs.
Conduct independent estimate reviews, cost reconciliations, and validation exercises to assess estimate completeness, accuracy, and reasonableness.
Perform statistical and risk-based sampling of quantities, labour rates, equipment pricing, production assumptions, indirect costs, subcontractor quotations, and contingency allocations.
Validate contractor estimates, change orders, claims, and forecast updates.
Assess compliance with approved estimating methodologies, governance requirements, and funding obligations.
Identify cost risks, opportunities, and corrective actions while providing recommendations to improve forecast reliability and cost certainty.

Contingency & Risk Management

Lead contingency planning, development, validation, and management processes throughout all project phases.
Support qualitative and quantitative risk assessments and evaluate contingency adequacy based on project maturity and risk exposure.
Monitor contingency utilization and provide recommendations regarding contingency drawdown requests.
Lead risk-adjusted forecasting and cost-to-complete reviews.
Identify emerging risks and opportunities and implement proactive mitigation strategies.
Provide early warning indicators and recommendations to support informed project decision-making.

Procurement & Contract Advisory

Develop procurement and contracting strategies aligned with project objectives, market conditions, and delivery model requirements.
Lead the preparation of tender and bidding documentation, including scope packages, commercial requirements, evaluation criteria, and pricing structures.
Manage procurement processes including bidder communications, RFI responses, tender clarifications, bid evaluations, and commercial assessments.
Support negotiations and provide recommendations for contract award.
Advise clients on Canadian contract forms and delivery models, including CCDC contracts, Progressive Design-Build agreements, and collaborative contracting structures.
Provide guidance regarding commercial risk allocation, contractor engagement strategies, and procurement best practices.
Review and assess contractor claims, change requests, and commercial disputes while supporting dispute avoidance efforts through proactive commercial engagement.

Value Engineering & Cost Optimization

Lead value engineering studies and option analyses to optimize project scope, budget, and overall value.
Provide whole-life cost and total cost of ownership assessments to support strategic investment decisions.
Conduct benchmarking and escalation analyses using internal and external cost intelligence databases.
Develop recommendations that balance capital cost, operational performance, schedule objectives, and risk exposure.
Support continuous improvement initiatives and lessons learned programs to improve cost performance across projects.

Post-Contract Services

Provide ongoing commercial and cost advisory services during project execution.
Lead change management reviews, cost forecasting, and performance assessments.
Validate commercial impacts arising from scope growth, project risks, and design evolution.
Review contractor estimates for changes, claims, variations, and compensation events.
Support dispute avoidance and resolution through objective commercial analysis and transparent stakeholder engagement.
Conduct independent assessments of project cost performance and forecast accuracy.

Client Advisory & Stakeholder Management

Act as the primary day-to-day point of contact for clients, lenders, consultants, designers, contractors, and project stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
Provide consulting services related to project controls, cost governance, commercial management, procurement, funding assurance, and organizational capability development.
Deliver market intelligence regarding labour availability, material pricing trends, contractor capacity, escalation pressures, and procurement strategies.
Present clear, data-driven cost, commercial, schedule, and risk insights to executive stakeholders, governance committees, and project teams.
Facilitate cost workshops, estimate reviews, Collaborative Cost Validation Framework sessions, value engineering workshops, and lessons-learned briefings.
Prepare executive reports, presentations, recommendations, and decision-support materials to support governance and investment decisions.

Leadership & Business Development

Lead multidisciplinary teams delivering cost management, commercial advisory, and project assurance services.
Support proposal development, client relationship management, and business growth initiatives.
Contribute to the development of methodologies, tools, frameworks, and best practices.
Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, industry partners, and stakeholders.
Knowledge management – Ensuring that key information and learning generated from each commission is input into the Turner & Townsend internal database. Ensure commissions are delivered to agreed scope, schedule, and quality standards; align delivery with conditions of appointment and project governance
Staff management– Input into performance review process of consultants and graduate consultants. Mentor junior team members, support capability building, and contribute to internal training initiatives.
Business Development – Identify opportunities with existing and new clients. Help develop long‑term, trusted‑advisor relationships& support growth by developing new business opportunities with existing and new Turner & Townsend clients.

Qualifications

Required

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, Finance, Commerce, or a related discipline.
Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in cost management, estimating, project controls, commercial management, project assurance, or capital project advisory services.
Significant experience supporting major capital projects exceeding $500M in value.
Extensive experience providing both pre-contract and post-contract advisory services.
Demonstrated expertise in cost estimating, cost assurance, benchmarking, forecasting, contingency management, procurement, and commercial advisory.
Strong consulting and client-facing experience, including executive stakeholder engagement.
Experience leading independent estimate reviews, cost assurance programs, and governance initiatives.
Strong understanding of project controls, commercial management, and project delivery principles.
Strong knowledge of Canadian construction markets and contract forms (e.g., CCDC); demonstrated expertise in change control, forecasting, and cost reporting.
Proficiency with cost management and productivity tools (e.g., CostX or equivalent, Excel, and data visualization such as Power BI).
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to present to executive‑level stakeholders.
Fluency in English and French
Ability to work in client office (downtown Montreal) for at least 2 times

Why Valtech? We’re the experience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.

Build, retain, and develop a high-performing team of Shopify architects, engineers, and solution leads—setting clear expectations, creating growth paths, and fostering a culture of technical excellence.

Sales Engagement & Client Partnership

Own the technical narrative in the sales process: participate actively in discovery, solutioning, estimation, architecture design, and proposal development for Shopify Plus pursuits.
Partner closely with business development and account teams to identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing Shopify Plus engagements.

Maintain and deepen relationships with Shopify’s partner and alliance teams, ensuring we are positioned for early access to new programs, beta capabilities, and co-sell opportunities.

Practice Development & Talent Growth

Mentor and coach Shopify architects, technical leads, and engineers across regions—actively investing in their growth and career trajectories.
Drive Shopify-specific certification and enablement programs (e.g., Shopify Partner certifications, Shopify Developer certifications) and build learning paths that keep the team at the forefront of platform innovation.
Contribute to internal knowledge sharing, solution playbooks, case studies, and reusable architecture assets that accelerate delivery and sales across the practice.

Utilization Optimization: Maintain or improve team utilization rates across all Shopify Plus engagements, targeting 70%+ blended team utilization.
Certification Growth: Drive 100% of the practice team to hold at least one Shopify Partner or Developer certification within 12 months.
Solution Quality: Ensure architectural integrity, scalability, and maintainability across all delivered Shopify Plus solutions—measured by client satisfaction scores and post-launch performance benchmarks.
Sales Pipeline Contribution: Actively participate in pursuits contributing to at least $8M in unweighted Shopify Commerce pipeline annually, with a target of closing $3M+ in new logos or significant expansions.
Individual Billability: Maintain a minimum of 50% individual billable utilization, balanced against the practice-building and sales activities inherent to this role.
Team Retention & Growth: Achieve 85%+ retention within the practice and maintain a pipeline of at least two internal candidates ready for promotion annually.

Must Have Qualifications

To be considered for this role, you must meet the following essential qualifications:

10+ years of experience in enterprise technology leadership within a consulting, systems integration, or agency environment—with at least 3–4 years specifically in Shopify Plus or a comparable enterprise commerce platform.
Deep, hands-on expertise in the Shopify Plus platform: Shopify Functions, Checkout Extensibility, Markets Pro, B2B, headless/composable commerce architectures, and the Shopify app ecosystem.
Strong command of the enterprise commerce technology stack surrounding Shopify Plus—including ERP integrations (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite), enterprise search (Elasticsearch, Algolia), CDPs (Segment, mParticle, Salesforce Data Cloud), PIM, OMS, and payment platforms.
Proven track record of participating in or leading sales pursuits, proposals, and client-facing solutioning conversations—comfortable owning a technical narrative in a competitive deal.
Experience building, leading, and growing distributed technical teams—hiring, mentoring, retaining senior talent, and creating cultures of technical excellence.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; able to operate fluently across executive, technical, and commercial audiences.

Preferred Certifications

Shopify Partner Certification, Shopify Developer Certification, or Shopify Plus Certification (required or expected within 6 months of hire).
AWS/Azure/GCP Solutions Architect, TOGAF, SAFe, PMP, or equivalent—demonstrating both platform-level and enterprise architecture credentials.

Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.

The Benefits

. The offered salary range is $150,000-225,000 CAD
annually, depending on experience and location.

Les joueurs sont récompensés pour le temps et l'argent qu'ils consacrent aux jeux et peuvent échanger ces récompenses contre des cartes cadeaux. Mistplay a pour mission d'être le meilleur moyen de jouer à des jeux mobiles pour tous, partout dans le monde ! Téléchargez Mistplay sur le Google Play Store  ici  et suivez-nous sur  Instagram ,  Twitter  et  Facebook .

📍 Veuillez noter :
Au Canada 🇨🇦, Mistplay suit un modèle hybride de 2 jours/semaine en bureau à Toronto (400 University Ave) & Montréal (1001 Blvd. Robert-Bourassa)

Mistplay is the #1 loyalty app for mobile gamers. Our community of millions of engaged mobile gamers come to Mistplay to discover new games to play and earn rewards. Gamers are rewarded for their time and money spent within the games and can redeem those rewards for gift cards. Mistplay is on a mission to be the best way to play mobile games for everyone everywhere! Download Mistplay on the Google Play Store  here  and follow us on  Instagram ,  Twitter  and  Facebook .

📍 Please Note:
In Canada 🇨🇦, Mistplay follows a 2 days/week in-office hybrid model in Toronto (400 University Ave) & Montreal (1001 Blvd. Robert-Bourassa)

🇫🇷  La description en français est ci-dessous ⬇️ 
Overview
Mistplay is the loyalty platform for mobile gamers. Players earn real rewards for playing games on Android and iOS, game studios pay us to acquire players who stay, and our LoyaltyPlay offerwalls extend that economy into other publishers' apps. A rewards economy can sometimes attract people who want the rewards without the play, and the ways they try keep changing: device farms, emulators, multi-accounting, referral abuse, account takeover, spoofed playtime and purchases, and low-quality traffic on the supply we sell to advertisers.

AI has changed the nature of that fight. Attackers now use it to generate accounts, mimic real play sessions, write convincing appeals and automate offerwall completions at a scale and speed that rule-based defences were never built for. We believe the answer is to be better at AI than they are. We're looking for a leader who will build stronger detection, prevention and mitigation, including through the use of AI: agents that triage and investigate, models that learn faster than attackers adapt, and tooling that lets a small team cover a large and shifting surface.

You will be accountable for our fraud strategy, our fraud roadmap and the metrics demonstrating ongoing and improved fraud prevention the company runs on, and you'll report on all three to the Senior Leadership Team and the board. You won't do it alone. You'll work in a tight coordination with our Fraud Analytics Manager and an Engineering Manager, who bring the analysts and engineers; together you define the roadmap, and you are the one accountable for landing it, working with Product to get it into plans and shipped.

This is a hands-on role in the sense that matters: you'll be in the data, running investigations, prototyping detection logic, shaping enforcement policy and running the response when an attack hits. It starts as a senior individual contributor position, and we expect it to grow: as the function matures there is room for this person to take on direct reports.

What You'll Be Doing

Own the fraud strategy and roadmap. Keep a clear, current picture of where we're exposed and what it costs, decide what we tackle this quarter and next, and turn that into a roadmap the Fraud Analytics, Engineering and Product teams commit to. Bring new features, offers and reward mechanics through an abuse review before they launch, and push back when something isn't ready

Be the accountable owner of Mistplay's fraud metrics. Define how we measure loss, prevalence and false positives, make sure the numbers are trusted, and deliver regular updates on our fraud posture, strategy and progress to the Senior Leadership Team and the board

Lead detection and enforcement work with the Fraud Analytics and other cross-functional teams. Set the investigation agenda, dig into live attack patterns alongside the analysts, prototype the rules and models that stop them, and hand clean specs to engineering to productionise. Own the enforcement ladder, from warnings and holds through to account and device bans, and the appeals policy behind it, so that real players aren't the collateral. You’ll also work cross-functionally with our commercial and marketing teams to ensure coordination and resolution with our clients and our marketing channels

Stand up fraud on-call and incident response. Build the on-call rotation and the incident response playbooks and procedures for fraud events, with clear severity levels, escalation paths and communication to the business. When an incident happens, run it: contain the attack, coordinate analytics, engineering, support and finance, and keep leadership informed. Afterwards, own the post-incident review and report, and make sure the mitigations that prevent a repeat get prioritised and shipped

Protect the quality of what we sell. Set traffic-quality standards for LoyaltyPlay and our third-party offerwall publishers, decide how we score and act on publisher-level fraud, and own the install-quality story we tell advertisers, including how we handle disputes

Make the function AI-native. Bring LLM and coding agents into day-to-day fraud work, from triage and evidence gathering to first-pass investigations, with people making the final enforcement calls. Help the analytics team adopt them, and keep an eye on AI-driven abuse as a threat in its own right

Own our platform and vendor choices. Decide how we use Play Integrity, App Attest and our MMP's fraud tooling, evaluate device-intelligence and bot-detection vendors against measured results, and make the call on what we buy

Influence across the company. Fraud touches Commercial, Marketing, Engineering, Product, UA, Supply, Support, Finance and Legal. You'll be the person who keeps everyone clear on what good looks like and what they own, without needing formal authority over any of them

What We're Looking For

10-12 or more years in fraud, risk, trust and safety or anti-abuse, much of it at a consumer platform, mobile ad network, MMP or rewards business. You've personally dealt with several of the threats above and can talk in detail about what worked and what didn't

Comfortable and current in the data. Strong SQL, enough Python to prototype and analyse, and a track record of designing detection logic that ran in production, even if someone else deployed it

Sharp analytical and critical reasoning: you can size a loss, weigh it against the cost of a control, and make a call you can defend to a CFO

Experience owning a fraud or risk strategy and roadmap, and presenting it to senior leadership or a board

You've run fraud or security incidents end to end, ideally having set up the on-call and incident response process yourself, and you can show how your post-incident work stopped the same thing happening twice

Proven ability to get things done through teams you don't manage, and to partner well with analytics and engineering leaders who do

AI-forward in practice: you use LLM and coding agents in your own work, you've applied AI to detection or investigation before, and you have a grounded view of where it helps and where a human has to decide

Working familiarity with Play Integrity, App Attest or DeviceCheck, MMP fraud suites and the device-intelligence vendor landscape

Strong communication and collaborative skills, including strong follow-through

Nice to have: Rewarded gaming, offerwall or incentivized UA experience; Databricks or Spark; graph or link analysis; mobile client security knowledge; prior people management or a desire to grow into it

What Mistplay Offers

Real ownership of a domain that protects revenue, player trust and advertiser relationships, and presenting fraud strategy and results directly to the Senior Leadership Team and the board.

A Fraud Analytics team and an Engineering Manager as your day-to-day partners, inside an AI forward, fast paced engineering culture 

A role designed to grow with you, including the option to build and lead a team as the function expands

Competitive compensation and benefits package.

Interview Process
A conversation about your experience, a fraud strategy case & a hands-on data exercise (AI assistants welcome), and an onsite conversation with the CTO & Fraud Analytics Manager & Fraud Engineering Manager where you walk through your case the way you would on-the-job with senior leadership.

Mistplay est la plateforme de fidélisation pour les joueurs mobiles. Les joueurs gagnent de vraies récompenses en jouant à des jeux sur Android et iOS, les studios de jeux nous paient pour acquérir des joueurs engagés, et nos mur d'offres LoyaltyPlay étendent cette économie aux applications d'autres éditeurs. Nous recherchons un leader qui saura bâtir une détection, une prévention et une atténuation plus fortes, notamment grâce à l'utilisation de l'IA : des agents qui trient et enquêtent, des modèles qui apprennent plus vite que les fraudeurs s'adaptent, et des outils permettant à une petite équipe de couvrir une surface vaste et évolutive.

Détenir la stratégie et la feuille de route anti-fraude.
